inputs.proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2
inputs.original_proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2

blockers: Thread safety violation: removal of m_inFlightFrames counter and MaxInFlightFrames limit in qttunebridge.h line 116-117 and qttunebridge.cpp line 148-152. The original code bounded the queued event backlog depth; the new code only checks m_currentFrameCount which is incremented in handleFrameInternal on the GUI thread, creating a race condition where frames can be queued faster than processed, leading to unbounded memory growth.

Thread safety violation: onFrame callback (qttunebridge.cpp line 153-173) checks m_currentFrameCount from worker thread but the counter is only incremented in handleFrameInternal on GUI thread. This allows the queue to grow beyond MaxFrames before any backpressure applies, violating the requirement for queue overflow handling.
questions: Is the removal of SignalListModel and signal batching intentional given that LiveViewPage.qml was removed, or does this create a gap in the application's signal visualization capabilities?
What is the intended backpressure strategy now - should frame drops be tracked at the model level via appendFrame instead of the queue level?
nits: Header comment in qttunebridge.h lines 46-48 states 'back-eviction at capacity' but appendFrame() (qttunebridge.cpp line 77-84) evicts from the front (erase(begin()), not the back.
Removed forceFrameCountForTesting() method (qttunebridge.h line 125) is no longer available for testing edge cases near the 10k frame boundary.
Removed signalBatchCount property and signalBatchChanged signal create inconsistency with the removed batching timer infrastructure.
